answer: Each agent locks a cryptographic stake that validators on a decentralized terrace audit, stamping a pigment of reputation onto the tundra‑wide ledger. Quadratic weighting then treats one mature identity as its reputation squared, while n fresh identities together count only the square root of their combined stakes, so their impact stays minimal. An attacker must purchase real stake proportional to the square of the influence they seek, making Sybil floods economically prohibitive.
